desc.zh: 用两个距离限制推导滑动窗口与数值桶，逐步检查每一次到期和匹配。
desc.en: Derive a sliding window and value buckets from two distance limits.

complexity: Expected O(n) time; O(min(n, indexDiff)) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Index-bounded window
concepts.description: Retain exactly the preceding positions within the inclusive index distance.

concepts.name: Integer value buckets
concepts.description: Use width valueDiff + 1 and check the current and adjacent buckets.

concepts.name: Bucket-window invariant
concepts.description: Expire before probing and insert only after excluding all earlier witnesses.
